brief:
Judges in Benjamin Netanyahu's corruption trial recommended Wednesday that prosecutors drop one of two bribery cases against the Israeli caretaker prime minister, Al-Monitor reported. The recommendation marked a significant development in the long-running proceedings, which have dogged Netanyahu's political career for years.

The court's move strengthens Netanyahu's legal position as he faces multiple corruption charges. The trial has continued through his various tenures as prime minister and during periods when he held the caretaker role.
dek: Judges in the long-running corruption trial of Israeli caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu handed his defence a major boost on Wednesday in recommending the prosecution drop one of the cases in which he is accused of bribery.
title: Israeli judges recommend dropping Netanyahu bribery charge
